summary: RED is genuinely causal (one real pending issuance/outbox row survived a non-delegated journal rejection while current production advanced the genuine 1→2 close and then hit D110C_0C1A_RETIREMENT_CHECKPOINT_UNAVAILABLE on the next close). GREEN closes exactly that defect with the three frozen internal checks in packages/node/src/v3-live.ts — unconditional post-commit halt in committedFailure(), exact ISSUANCE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN halt without a policy reservation, halt recheck in stageClosedBlueprintEpoch() after the registration-queue barrier, and creatorCloseRegistration() refusal — with no wire/schema/API/dependency/authority/threshold change. Custody, signatures, tree hash, manifests, source hashes, and both reporters verify exactly as claimed. No P0/P1 findings.

findings.evidence: .logs/d110c-0c1b-red-4d616285/status.json classification CAUSAL_RED_WITH_POSTRUN_WRAPPER_CAPTURE_ERROR, runnerExitCode null; report.json is complete with success=false, 1 selected file, 1 failed test

findings.required_action: Disposition: accept as disclosed; the durable report.json (numFailedTests=1, success=false) plus validation.txt token/throw-site uniqueness establish RED; no rerun needed or permitted
